note: Maintainer decision 11 (#1316 finding 3): native variable 6 is pinned `kon`, the slug the split `1.5.kon` of the other native family 5 also takes. Family 5 delivers the case twins Kon and KON together, so `1.5.kon` stays an ambiguous name, not a declaration, and before the fix variable 6 published `kon` beside it. Both names are refused, each located at its own [[variable]] entry; variable 6 is withheld as an unresolved catalog identity, and family 5 stays withheld as before. A split that keeps its own family's slug is the partial name, not a collision: `split-partition-reviewed-owner-sharing-a-generated-name-withholds-only-the-uncovered-variant`.
fails_if: `refuse_slug_collisions` (source_naming.py) stops counting an ambiguous family's names as slug holders, or `compile_curation` stops running it over the merged scope, so variable 6 publishes `kon` with no `naming_slug_collision`
